concatenate: &You describe the warehouse to the best of your ability.  John listens intently

concatenate.yes: , then shakes his head.  "I don't believe I've heard about anything like that, no.  Sorry."
concatenate.no: , looking thoughtful.  "I can't guarantee it, but I'm pretty sure I've seen something like that.  It was far away, and the weather was bad.  Could've been a church or something, but it didn't look right for that."
